maddeler.e:
أنطلب (form VII)
# أَنْطَلِبُ (ʔanṭalibu) /ʔan.tˤa.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# أَنْطَلِبَ (ʔanṭaliba) /ʔan.tˤa.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# أَنْطَلِبْ (ʔanṭalib) /ʔan.tˤa.lib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
